$comment: Registry of sample-source libraries used as audio test sources for the SPD-SX / Circuit Tracks work. Actual audio (raw/ and spdsx/) is gitignored and local-only; this file + README.md are committed so the tree can be rebuilt after a delete. These are Kontakt libraries installed via Native Access, so they ship as encrypted .nkx/.nkc/.nkr monoliths you cannot ffmpeg directly. The 'bounce' step means rendering articulations out of Kontakt to WAV into raw/, then running samples:to-spdsx.

runtime.name: Kontakt 8 Player
runtime.role: Required host to open the .nki/.nkr libraries below and render (bounce) their sounds to WAV.

kits.label: invasion
kits.name: Invasion ("The Invasion")
kits.delivery: Native Instruments Kontakt Player library via Native Access
kits.sampleFormat: Kontakt monoliths (.nkx/.nkc/.nkr), encrypted — not directly convertible
kits.bounce: Open The Invasion.nkr in Kontakt 8, render each pad/articulation to WAV into invasion/raw/, then: npm run samples:to-spdsx -- invasion
kits.notes: A prior loose download (C:/Users/Steph/Downloads/Invasion/ + Invasion.zip) was deleted ~2026-06-13 and is not in the Recycle Bin; re-installed cleanly via Native Access on 2026-06-20.

kits.label: sleep-token-ii
kits.name: Sleep Token II
kits.bounce: npm run samples:to-spdsx -- sleep-token-ii (per-key WAVs already bounced to samples/mixwave/keys)
kits.notes: MIDI Files/ ships TWO packs: 'Sleep Token II - Groove Pack' (160 files: 31 Fill + 129 Groove, across 10 Song NN (BPM) folders — the one all scripts point at) and 'Sleep Token II - Groove Pack LITE' (12-file teaser, 8 song folders, unused by any script). The Song NN numbering does NOT alias between the two packs (LITE's Song 06 is 150 BPM vs the full pack's Song 06 at 120 BPM) — don't assume shared song identity if LITE is ever touched.
